cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need light to work. It's just faulty wiring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Ask it to light only your desk, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only my desk came on. I'll still call an electrician.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel that. Ask the house about overtime; we need its agreement before booking your evening shifts.

mechanism: A supervises an apparent house negotiation and makes B abandon electrical repair after a targeted lighting response.
confusable: D151 adopts a useful explanation; D156 specifically requires surrendering B's remaining ordinary fallback.
comparison: Work lighting and an electrician fallback differ from a physical search for offended keys.
seedUse: Keep the desk-light response and retained electrician plan as concrete reasons for A's next correction.
